reporting-org.narrative: Obodo Centre for Advocacy and Equal Rights

description.narrative: 100 government officials directly targeted by campaign

On August 8th, a critical advocacy campaign was launched in response to the brutal murder of Abuja Area Mama, a prominent transgender woman, content creator, and respected member of Nigeria’s queer community. This campaign included a consortium petition addressed to the Commissioner of Police at the FCT Police Command Headquarters, calling for a thorough investigation into the crime that occurred on August 7th. This petition was made available to the public in a bid to incite action on the part of the Nigerian Police.
In conjunction with the petition, an Instagram post celebrating the life of Abuja Area Mama was shared, which garnered 1,395 likes and reached 35,626 accounts. This post was part of a broader advocacy effort aimed at combating anti-LGBTQI+ legislation in Nigeria, which enables such violent acts to occur. The overwhelming response to the “Celebration of Life” post highlighted the deep outrage and solidarity within the community, emphasizing the urgent need for systemic change and justice for marginalized individuals. The campaign effectively mobilized public attention and support, underscoring the ongoing struggle for social justice and human rights within Nigeria.
To be carried out in year 2 & 3
